description: This file defines a React component for managing folders within a note-taking application. It includes UI elements for creating, renaming, and deleting folders, and interacts with a context providing note and folder data and functions.

methods.name: FolderManagerScreenEnhanced
methods.description: Main React component for folder management UI, enabling creating, renaming, and deleting folders.

methods.name: BackButton
methods.description: A small button component to navigate back or dismiss the folder management view.

methods.name: FolderRow
methods.description: Component representing a single folder item with rename and delete options.
